learning_outcomes.text: Ability to master the physical and mechanical properties of materials, heat treatment, and phase diagrams
Ability to know the general properties of engineering materials
Ability to create the function-purpose and constraints cycle in product design and determine the general properties of the required material.
Knowing the material selection methodology and being able to select materials using the necessary data sources
Ability to observe the behavior of the selected material according to the product and environment
Ability to select materials in design according to application areas

syllabus_topics: Materials and Design, Development of Engineering Materials, Industrial Size and Material Selection
Engineering Materials Families, Metals, Ceramics, Polymers, Glasses, Elastomers and Hybrid Materials, Functional Classification of Materials
Material Design and Selection, Design Principles and Selection Criteria, Product and Components, Product Function Definition and Loading Conditions
Material Property and Manufacturing Process Effects, Reverse Engineering, Material Selection and Data Sources
Effect of alloying elements on the properties of steels
Use, types and coding of steel and cast iron
Production and applications of composite materials
Damage to materials. Sources of damage and prevention (fracture, fatigue, creep)
Damage to materials, their sources and prevention (oxidation, corrosion, friction, adhesion wear)
Case studies on material selection in industrial products
bibliography: Wadhwa, A. S., Dhaliwal, E. H.S. (2008). A textbook of engineering material and metallurgy. India: Firewall Media.
Rajput, R. K. (2008). Engineering material. New Delhi: S. Chand & Company.
